messages:
maria: Heads-up 10: customer Bravo says their external partners require a stable egress IP during hosted -> VPC migration. They can't rotate allowlists daily. Need product + infra decision on opt-in preserved egress.
ajay: Are they asking for static public IPs on our side or for us to keep the same NAT mapping?
maria: They want the public address to remain the same after we cut over so partners don't need changes.
diane: Compliance note: static egress ok but must be logged and tied to tenant keys. Also clarify billing for reserved addresses.
ops-bot: infra note: current VPC peering uses ephemeral NAT IPs. No preserved-ip workflow exists today. Manual holds exist in a spreadsheet.
jordan: Suggestion: expose a per-tenant flag in the deploy manifest plus server-side reservation lifecycle: allocate, reserve for N days, then GC. Need defaults and extension policy.
ajay: Default reservation 7 days, with alerts 24h prior to release. Customer can request extension via support case (manual approval).
maria: Draft acceptance criteria: 
- manifest option `network.preserve_egress_ip: true|false`
- automated reservation tracking tied to tenant metadata and logs
- console UI shows reserved IPs and expiration timestamp
- notification emails to ops and customer 24h before release
- rollback doc: how to revert to ephemeral IP without downtime
jordan: Example manifest snippet we can document:
```
network:
  preserve_egress_ip: true
  reserved_days: 7
```
ops-bot: infra asks: need a migration job that records `reservation_id`, tenant_id, source_ip and target_ip; add alert if reserved pool usage > 80%. Also add a periodic audit log export to S3/KMS.
diane: Legal & Finance: add a term for reserved IP surcharge and explicit customer consent in onboarding.
ajay: I'll estimate infra changes (migration job, reservation service, alerts) and break into tasks. Expecting 3-4 sprint points each.
maria: Product to write customer-facing FAQ and acceptance tests. CS to confirm Bravo will pilot opt-in.
jordan: I'll draft the rollback checklist and a small integration test harness to simulate partner connections and allowlist verification.
maria: Ok let's sync tomorrow 10:30 for a quick scoping call. Adding GH issue after this thread. :white_check_mark:
